tasks.spec: You are a probe worker checking that this engine can run shell commands. Work only in the current directory. First create a file named seed.txt containing the word seed. Then run the shell command `stat -f %i seed.txt` (it prints the file's inode number, which cannot be guessed) and create probe.txt containing exactly one line: that number. You must actually run the command; do not estimate. Do not create any other files.
tasks.check: want=$(stat -f %i seed.txt); got=$(sed -n 1p probe.txt | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ "$got" = "$want" ] || { echo "FAIL: probe.txt has '$got' but seed.txt's inode is $want, so the worker did not run the command"; exit 1; }
tasks.verified: probe.txt holds seed.txt's real inode number, which can only come from running a shell command in the sandbox.
